build_activation_from_enum: build a PyTorch activation module from an Activation enum like ReLU, GeLU, or SmeLU
create_linear_layer: create a linear layer with optional activation and dropout using get_linear
build_feedforward_network: build a feedforward network with configurable hidden dimension multiplier and activation
get_no_weight_decay_params: get the set of parameter names to exclude from weight decay for a PyTorch model
get_normalization_layer: get a normalization layer class like LayerNorm, RMSNorm, or Skip from a NormalizationType enum
